title: 第一卷 第25章 洪铁虎
content_zh:
秦绝淡淡一笑：“你是个聪明人。既然如此，以后你李家，便是我秦家的附属家族，可得我秦府庇护。但只是上缴五成利润不够，还需与我秦家共同进退。若有怯退和背叛，莫怪我刀下无情。”

    李东明心中激动，秦绝一个‘李家’，就等于是认可他的身份了，在如今的凤州城，只要是秦绝认可的事，谁敢二话？

    “多谢秦少，老朽定当与主家同心，共同进退！”李东明恭敬抱拳，一脸欣喜。

    秦绝点头道：“你先回去吧，以后抽成分利之事，和韩汐对接即可。”

    “是。”李东明答应一声，起身离开。

    “还是韩家人聪明啊，送了一个这么漂亮能干的女儿来伺候秦少爷。只可惜，老朽儿的三个女儿，都已出嫁了，唉，嫁早了啊！”

    “咦，老夫可以收几个年轻貌美的女子为义女啊！到时候，嘿嘿嘿……”

    走出秦府的路上，李东明心里盘算着小九九，脸上的笑容，愈发猥琐。

    半个时辰后，秦绝和韩汐一道，来到西市的牙行。

    牙行里，有专门做活口买卖的一块区域。

    一些衣衫褴褛眼神暗淡的人，或是蹲在路边，或是被关在脏臭的木笼子里。

    蹲在路边的，大多是因为一些原因自愿卖身的，被关起来的，多是因为无法偿还所欠债务，亦或者是犯了其他罪责，而被强行发卖的。

    但不管是什么原因，到了这里，便是命如草芥。

    韩汐瞧了几个，青眉微皱。

    这些人连精神气都没有了，即便买回去了，也难堪大用。

    一个马脸高个，眼见秦绝、韩汐走过来，连忙咧嘴堆笑，迎了上来：“两位公子、小姐，可是要买活口？小人这里，有能干粗活重活的壮劳力，也有老实听话的小妇人，还有修为在身的高品武者，不论二位想买什么类型的，小人都能给二位挑几个最好的出来。”

    秦绝瞥了一眼马脸身后，只是一群瘦弱的男子和畏缩的妇人，便问道：“你说的高品武者，在哪里？”

    马脸男子眼神一亮，嘿笑道：“高品武者那是稀罕货，自然没有摆在外面。如果公子诚心想买，小人可以领着公子去关押他们的地方看看。不过么，这去上一趟，即便买卖没成，也是需要公子付点跑腿费的。”

    秦绝随手一掏，将五块灵石丢给马脸男子，道：“就这些。”

    马脸脸色一喜，激动道：“够了够了，公子大气！”
content_en:
Qin Jue smiled faintly: "You are a smart man. In this case, from now on, your Li family will be a subsidiary family of my Qin family and can be protected by my Qin family. But just handing over 50% of the profits is not enough. You still need to advance and retreat together with my Qin family. If there is timidity or betrayal, don't blame me for being ruthless."

    Li Dongming was excited. Qin Jue's membership in the "Li family" was tantamount to recognition of his identity. In today's Fengzhou City, as long as it is something Qin Jue approves of, who would dare to say anything about it?

    "Thank you, Mr. Qin. I will definitely work with my master to advance and retreat together!" Li Dongming clasped his fists respectfully, with a look of joy on his face.

    Qin Jue nodded and said, "You should go back first, and then you can just contact Han tide about the profit sharing."

    "Yes." Li Dongming agreed, stood up and left.

    "The Han family is smart enough to send such a beautiful and capable daughter to serve Master Qin. It's a pity that the old man's three daughters are already married. Alas, they got married too early!"

    "Hey, I can accept a few young and beautiful women as adopted daughters! When the time comes, hehehehe..."

    On the way out of Qin Mansion, Li Dongming was thinking about Xiao Jiujiu, and the smile on his face became more and more obscene.

    Half an hour later, Qin Jue and Han tide arrived at Yahang in the West City.

    In the tooth shop, there is an area dedicated to the live trade.

    Some people with ragged clothes and dull eyes were squatting on the roadside or locked in dirty and smelly wooden cages.

    Most of those squatting on the roadside voluntarily sold themselves for some reason. Those who were locked up were mostly forcibly sold because they were unable to repay debts they owed, or because they had committed other crimes.

    But no matter what the reason is, once you get here, your life is like a straw.

    Han tide looked at a few of them and frowned slightly.

    These people have lost all their energy. Even if they buy them back, they will be unable to use them.

    A tall man with a horse face saw Qin Jue and Han tide approaching. He grinned quickly and greeted them: "You two young masters and ladies, do you want to buy a living? Here, I have strong laborers who can do rough and heavy work, as well as honest and obedient young women, and high-quality warriors with good cultivation. No matter what type you two want to buy, I can choose the best ones for you."

    Qin Jue glanced at the group of thin men and cowering women behind Ma Lian, and asked: "Where is the high-quality warrior you mentioned?"

    The horse-faced man's eyes lit up and he said with a smile: "High-grade warriors are rare items, so naturally they are not put out there. If the young master sincerely wants to buy them, I can take him to the place where they are held. However, this is a trip. Even if the sale fails, the young master still needs to pay some errand fees."

    Qin Jue took out the five spiritual stones and threw them to the horse-faced man, saying, "That's it."

    Ma Lian's face lit up and he said excitedly: "That's enough, that's enough, sir!"
